verdict.rationale: Increase is a banking API platform for storing and moving money. It is not an agent or assistant that consumes tools, so acting as an MCP client is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows Increase can consume external tools: the llms.txt, OpenAPI and CLI probes describe how others integrate with Increase, not how Increase connects to MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
